old.name: "Vin Jaune" tasting on a Place de la Liberté terrace
old.label: AVOID
old.hook: Real Vin Jaune is tasted at the producer's, not under the arcades
old.text: Real Vin Jaune is tasted at the producer's, not under the arcades If the bottle on the terrace is 75 cl, it isn't Vin Jaune — Vin Jaune is mandatorily 62 cl clavelin , the format is legally protected. Several centre-town "dégustation" cellars in Lons and Arbois pour topped-up oxidative Savagnin under the name and charge tourist prices. Real Vin Jaune is tasted at the winemaker's: Macle in Château-Chalon, Tissot in Montigny, or at the Caveau des Jacobins in Lons. The 62 cl clavelin is the proof of identity.

old.name: Industrial "Comté" at a tourist cellar
old.label: AVOID
old.hook: Three ages side by side, or it's not the real lesson
old.text: Three ages side by side, or it's not the real lesson Cellars selling pre-cut Comté in plastic at €25/kg are selling young, mass-affined wheels. Real Comté differentiates radically by age and affineur — Marcel Petite's Fort Saint-Antoine wheels at 24+ months are a different cheese from a 12-month industrial wheel. Buy from a real fromager-affineur — Fromagerie Vagne on rue du Commerce, or at the Thursday market — and taste three ages side by side before deciding.

old.name: Looking for Jeunet at 9 rue de l'Hôtel de Ville in Arbois
old.label: AVOID
old.hook: The historic address has been closed since Jean-Paul Jeunet's retirement
old.text: The historic address has been closed since Jean-Paul Jeunet's retirement Jean-Paul Jeunet retired; Steven Naessens took the name and the two stars to the Château de Germigney in Port-Lesney in November 2021. The old Arbois address at 9 rue de l'Hôtel de Ville no longer operates as a starred restaurant. Many guides (including the previous version of this one) still send readers there. The current address is Maison Jeunet par Steven Naessens, 31 rue Edgar Faure, 39600 Port-Lesney .

old.name: Besançon — La Rodia SMAC
old.label: ELECTRONIC
old.hook: The regional SMAC for current music · the closest electronic programme to Lons
old.text: The regional SMAC for current music · the closest electronic programme to Lons Besançon's La Rodia is the Franche-Comté SMAC — 600-cap, year-round programme of rock, hip-hop, electronic and world music. Closer than Lyon (which is a longer 1h30 south to Le Sucre , the rooftop on La Sucrière). For Nuits Sonores (mid-May in Lyon) the trip is worth the drive. The Jura itself has none of this. Where Besançon — 1 h north
